intents.raw: 测一下 canary（http://localhost:4100，接口文档在 /openapi.json）的下单接口在并发下会不会超卖

missions.objective: GET http://localhost:4100/openapi.json and describe the ordering and inventory endpoints: paths, methods, request/response fields, stock field semantics, and status codes. No state changes.

Provide cap:observe.state.poll.http: Poll a JSON resource field (e.g. product stock) at a fixed interval during a concurrent load burst and record the full time series with timestamps, so oversell checks can compare stock trajectories against expected decrements.
